boundaries.name: keccak-and-poseidon-binding
boundaries.obligation: solidity_keccak256 / hash_words and PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64 are opaque; the model produces the exact word streams only. Collision resistance, the Bytes32 encoding, and 'equal digest implies equal key/ciphertext' are not proved.

boundaries.name: upstream-regev-plonky3
boundaries.obligation: regev_plonky3::keygen / encrypt / decrypt / encode_value_message, the negacyclic NTT and the field type F are opaque; that they implement the ring arithmetic, that decryption inverts encryption, and that the upstream message encoder produces the modelled 64-bit little-endian layout are undischarged premises (DecryptsTo, HomomorphicDigits and the encodeAmount definition).

boundaries.name: rust-machine-and-serde
boundaries.obligation: Refinement of the Nat/Int model to Rust u32/u64/u128/i8 arithmetic, casts, Vec indexing, serde Serialize/Deserialize wire formats and the dropped String error payloads is not established.

boundaries.name: decryption-gadget-agreement
boundaries.obligation: Constant and word-stream agreement is proved against Zkp.Implementation.DecryptionGadget, itself a handwritten model of the in-circuit gadget; agreement between either model and the compiled Rust/plonky2 code is not established.
